en: There, there! You're fine now, Xiaojun! I'm right here, aren't I?
Waaah... Pingyan~
What a cute couple~ Don't you think, dear?
Yep! Tu Xingsun thinks so too!
Sis...
What's that tower?
The Tongtian Tower!
Tongtian Tower?
Long ago, Indra, lord of the Three Realms, led the Kunlun immortals against the ancient demon Tongtian. At terrible cost, they sealed him in this tower forever!
Tongtian?

When chaos first parted, the Supreme Patriarch couldn't reach the Way, for a demon still lurked in his heart. He trained 50 years in the Tongtian Tower until he cast it out... But that evil took a form of its own, and became a great force of darkness...
And that was Tongtian!
Exactly!

Tongtian hated the Patriarch for casting him off, and swore to conquer the Three Realms and make them a demon world. He gathered allies, split the Chan Sect, lured immortals who resented Kunlun, and founded the Jie Sect on Jin'ao Island. Ever since, Kunlun and Jin'ao have warred without end.
Tongtian founded the Jie Sect? And he's a piece of the Supreme Patriarch?
Yes. After 2,000 years of war, we wiped out the Jie Sect of that age. But...
However what?
Killing Tongtian would destroy the Patriarch's soul too. So, as Tongtian was part of him, Indra sealed him in the tower forever.
Then why now?
Only the mingled blood of three generals' stars who hate each other can break Tongtian's seal...
Three generals' stars? You mean...?
I do! You, Yin Wen and Ji Xiaojun.
S-so... from the very beginning...
Even bringing us to this era...
It was all Shen Gongbao's plan?
Exactly! Shen Gongbao was Kunlun's greatest traitor, and Tongtian's loyal servant!

Even Yin Wen and Xiaojun coming here, and all they did while possessed by Wen Zhong and the Nine-Tail Fox, was Shen Gongbao's plan. He meant to enrage you so you'd kill each other, and use your blood to break the seal!
Shen Gongbao... and Tongtian! I'll never forgive you!
Pingyan! Let's go teach those two creeps a lesson!
Let's? Does your "us" mean you and Xiaojun too?
Well, duh~
No way!
Why not?
Because I said so! It's way too dangerous!
Come on, Pingyan! Don't you get how we feel? None of what Xiaojun and I did here was by choice, and it tears us up inside. But there's no denying it... our hands are soaked in their blood...
Yin Wen...
I have to do something for all the innocent lives that died at my hands. So I'm done running away. Besides, we're generals' stars too, sworn to end this chaos!
Xiaojun...
Pingyan~ Say whatever you want! I'm going!
Fine, I get it! But let me say this up front! If we hit trouble, Yin Wen, you'd better protect Xiaojun!
Yeah, yeah, I know!
Okay! Let's move out!
Mm-hm!
Go on ahead. We have something to discuss with Pingyan.
Me?
Yes.
Got it. You guys go ahead! I'll catch up!
Let's go, Sis!
Mm.
So, what did you want to tell me?
It's like this...
Sis~ With Xiaojun back... I know how you feel. Go ahead and cry.
Hmph! Who'd cry?! That monkey-faced runt is short, ugly, nuts, clueless and brainless! Who'd cry over... him... who...
What did they tell you, bro?
Bro?
We're out of time! Let's go! Next stop, the Tongtian Tower!
This is the Kaitian Cave! Once you've got the Pangu Blade, I'll give you a lift onward!
Mm!
The Kaitian Cave is just ahead! Go get the Pangu Blade!
General's star, at last!
Who are you?
We are the ancient gods Pangu and Nuwa. You seek the Pangu Blade, yes?
That's right! For the future of the Three Realms, I need to borrow the Pangu Blade!
You may. But first we must clear your doubts, and be sure you are the true general's star.
Doubt?
That's right! Draw your sword!
Die, Pingyan!
Don't blame me for this! Pingyan~
If you can't even bring yourself to strike us, what good will you be in Zhaoge?
Cast off your attachments. They are no longer Yin Wen and Xiaojun, the childhood friends you knew.
I understand! I won't feel anything for them anymore. They may look like Yin Wen and Xiaojun, but they're not the people I knew. Bring it on!
Take this!
Huff... huff... I did it!
You truly are the general's star. The Pangu Blade and this world's fate are yours now!
Yes! I understand!
Before you head to Zhaoge, there's something I must make clear...
Please, go on.
Rather than let the Nine-Tail Fox and Wen Zhong use their bodies for atrocities, it's better to defeat them completely and set their souls free. I'm sure their souls are suffering terribly...
If it really comes to the point of no return... I know what I must do, for everyone's sake. That's a general's star's mission, I guess.
Well said! Take care! We leave this world to you!
Leave it to me!
Take care!
Take care!
Did you get the Pangu Blade?
Thanks to you!
Wonderful! Let's set off at once!
Mm!
So this is the Tongtian Tower! The final battle at last!
Wait for us!
What are you doing here?
Father rose up against Shang and swept all before him. We've taken Zhaoge! Then Yuanshi Tianzun told us what happened, so we rushed here. Pingyan! Let your big brother help!
Ha ha ha ha... With me, Huang Feihu, King Wucheng, here, nothing can stop us!
Ho ho ho... Things always get messier BECAUSE you're here, King Wucheng!
Heh heh... Listen, grandson~ This is crazy dangerous. We're up against the ancient demon Tongtian. Thanks, but no thanks!
Let me tell you something! If you think I'm the same old Huang Feihu, you're dead wrong! On the march to Zhaoge, I, King Wucheng, held off armies single-handed!
Really? I don't buy it!
If you don't believe me, Miss Yang Jian, ask Prince Ji Fa! Isn't that right, Prince?
Yes. King Wucheng tore through the enemy, and even saved my life when I was in trouble!
Not bad! That's my grandson!
Hmph! I still don't buy it. Back in Xiqi you talked so big about protecting us, then the moment you saw Grand Tutor Wen, you cowered like a drowned dog! How can anyone trust you, King Wucheng~

Wh-why you...! Hmph! Grand Tutor Wen... no! Wen Zhong! I, King Wucheng, fear no such man! I only put up with him because he was King Zhou's pet! Hmph! Wen Zhong's just a royal bootlicker! In a real fight, I, King Wucheng, could drop him with one finger!
Oh~ Are you really that tough?
Of course!
Do you truly think so, King Wucheng~?
W-W-Wen...!
One finger, was it? I'd love to see if King Wucheng can really drop me with a single finger!
M-mercy~! Your humble servant spoke out of turn... please forgive me...
Ho ho ho ho... You haven't changed a bit~
Easy, grandson~ No need to panic! He's not the Grand Tutor Wen you knew. He's my buddy Yin Wen.
Ha ha ha... Sorry about that, King Wucheng.
Tee hee... Yin Wen, you're so mean~
That's enough, Pingyan. Stop teasing King Wucheng.
You hear that, Yin Wen?
Yeah~ Yin Wen is soooo mean! Tee hee...
You're laughing too!
By the way, where's Leizhenzi?
You mean Beakface~? His master Yunzhongzi thought he was too weak and would drag us down, so he took him back to Mount Zhongnan to train.
I see.
Who says I'd drag you down?!
You?! What're you doing back? Beakface~
Came to collect your corpse, of course! Couldn't miss that! Beanpole~
Got stronger, Beakface? We've got no time to rescue you~
Heh heh heh... Likewise! I won't have time to save you either! When it gets scary, go ahead and run! I won't laugh!
It's only been a little while, but Leizhenzi got so much stronger~
You're too kind, Miss Yang Jian! But I've trained my heart out these days!
Gee, must've been tough for you! Beakface~
Quit pretending, bro~ You're thrilled Leizhenzi's back!
Wh-who's thrilled?!
I know Pingyan's happy right now! Right, Yin Wen?
Yep! Quit faking it, Pingyan!
Wh-why you guys!
Hey! How'd you know we were here? Weren't you training on Mount Zhongnan?
Master said since your foe is Tongtian, the demon who founded the Jie Sect, and the Three Realms are at stake, he sent me early to help, in case Beanpole and the gang get in trouble!
It'll be a hard fight, but with you, Prince Ji Fa and King Wucheng helping, I'm sure we can beat Tongtian!
Right! Tu Xingsun thinks so too! We're gonna win! Right, Chanyu?
Mm...
Come on! No time to stand around!
Soldiers! Entrust your lives to me, Huang Feihu, King Wucheng! Let's storm the Tongtian Tower!
Ha ha ha... Geez, Huang Feihu! Your lines are way too fired up!
Let's go, Pingyan~
Mm! Everyone, be careful out there!
Yeah!
Ho ho ho... Long time no see, traitor Huang Feihu, and Prince Ji Fa.

Hmph! Don't you two lapdogs act chummy with me! Before King Zhou branded me a wanted man, it was "King Wucheng" this and "King Wucheng" that. I thought you were my brothers! Never in my wildest dreams did I think YOU two killed my wife and children for King Zhou, and that it was your idea to make me an outlaw! You dogs, I'll never rest while you live!

We only played brothers because you were King Zhou's favorite! Ha ha ha ha ha... Don't make us laugh, King Wucheng~ Times have changed! For old times' sake, just kill yourself. Being so kind, I'll ask Lord Tongtian to leave your corpse in one piece!
Pingyan, leave this to us!
But...
These two murdered my eldest brother, Bo Yikao! I'll never forgive them!
Ho ho ho... Bo Yikao, eh? I'd almost forgotten about him. Say, Prince Ji Fa, did you ever ask your father how it felt to eat a meat pie made from his own son? Ha ha ha ha ha...
You monsters!
Pingyan! Leave it to me and King Wucheng! You go on ahead!
But I...
Go!
All right! I'm counting on you! Big bro, and my dear grandson!
Ha ha ha...! Got it! Now get moving!
Mm!
Heh heh heh... If you think we're the same old You Hun and Shu Zhong, you'll regret it, King Wucheng~
Enough talk! Show me what you've got!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha... Looks like nothing's changed at all~
Ho ho ho...
Do you really think so?
King Wucheng, something's not right here!
Ha ha ha... Small fry like these can't pull off anything!
Long live Lord Tongtian!
Die~!
Oh no!! It's too late!
Heh... heh...
Mis...sion...ac...com...plished...
Are... are... you... okay...? Prince...
Wh-why... did you... save me...
Be...cause... you're Ping...yan's... big... brother...
Hang... on... King... Wu...cheng...
Was... I... cool... just now...? ...
King... Wu...cheng...
What was that explosion?
That's grandson's aura!? Don't tell me he's... I'm going back!
Stop right there, Beanpole!
What do you think you're doing, Beakface?!
Forgot what your big brother said? Leave it to them!
But...
There's no turning back, bro~
... I get it. Let's head to the next floor!
Mm!
I am Jinling, Holy Mother of Gold! Come at me!
Long time no see, Jinling~
Is that you, Long Ji? It's been over two hundred years since we last met, hasn't it?
It seems this fated battle of ours can't be avoided.
Ho ho... Suits me fine!
Pingyan~ Go on ahead! I shall deal with Jinling myself!
Got it! I'm counting on you, Sis Long Ji.
"Sis," is it? Ho ho ho... how amusing!
Do you think your current power can match mine, Long Ji?
With my current power, I indeed can't match you, elder sister. But perhaps this is our fate.
Ho ho ho... Elder sister! You haven't called me that in centuries, have you?
If only you'd return to the Chan Sect, we could go back to how things were.
...It's too late for that! Have at you!
Yes!
Ugh... ugh... I... I...
Little sister... your meridians are shattered. Since we trained under one master, tell me your last wish. Your elder sister will grant it... Ugh... ugh...
These... two hundred... years... weren't... wasted... after all... elder sister...
Little... sister... you've... grown... stronger... We were... like real sisters... How did... we end up... like this...
I suppose... this is... fate... May I... call you... Sis... one more time...
Yes... go... ahead...
Sis...ter...
Long... Ji... my little... sis...ter...
Sis Long Ji~~!
Let's go!
I am Guiling, guardian of the third floor! I never thought a bunch of brats like you could make it this far!
Bring it! I don't care if you're Guiling or turtle jelly!
Insolent brat! Prepare to die!
Like I'm scared of you!
Hold it! Beanpole~
What now? Beakface!
Leave this turtle jelly to me alone. You guys hurry to the next floor!
You sure you can handle it alone? Beakface!
Relax, Monkey-face! I'll catch up as soon as I beat this thing! Besides, I still haven't seen you dressed up as a girl! I hear you were real pretty, huh?
You blabbermouth! It was you, wasn't it!
I-I'm innocent... Your Honor, I swear~ Tee hee hee...
You laughed! You told him! It was totally you!
This isn't the time to argue about that! Go! I'll catch up with you later!
I'm counting on you, Beakface... Don't you dare die!
Beanpole, Miss Yang Jian... I'll catch up with you later... if I'm still alive...
Done with your last words? Die, you freak bird!
Hyah!
You... you freak... bird... You're... not bad... Aaah...
Heh... heh... heh... Master... with this... your student... has done his job... Bean...pole... Miss... Yang Jian... farewell...
That was Beakface!? Don't tell me Beakface too...
Pingyan...
If you want to avenge Leizhenzi, you can't stand here grieving! Let's go, Pingyan~
Yin Wen...
Yin Wen's right! Let's go, Pingyan~
I get it! Just you wait!! Beakface... no! Leizhenzi! I, Ji Pingyan, will beat Tongtian and avenge you!
Hearing that, Leizhenzi's spirit must be so happy. It's the first time you called him Leizhenzi.
Yeah... Let's go!
Mm!
I'm amazed the likes of you made it this far. Quite something~ But this is the end of the line, for you'll all die right here!
You guys go ahead! Leave this to Tu Xingsun and Chanyu!
Be careful, Tu Xingsun!
Mm!
Don't you go dying here! She-devil!
Same to you! Witch~
Halt! You think this is an inn? Coming and going as you please?
Your opponent's right here!
Hurry, Pingyan! Tu Xingsun's got this!
Mm!
Die!
Aaah...
Th-this... is enough... Chan... Chan...yu... See you... in the next life... Chan...yu...
In... our next life... Chanyu... will... marry... you again... dear... goodbye...
Even Tu Xingsun and his wife...
She-devil...
Pingyan...
Let's go! We can't waste time here...
Let's go!
The Ten Lords?
Ho ho ho... So young, yet you know who I am?
You know him, bro~?
Yeah...
Is he that strong?
Master said 200 years ago, the Ten Lords invaded the Chan Sect alone and killed hundreds of us. It took Master, the Grand Master and four of my uncles to barely beat him...
No matter how strong he is, if we all team up now, I'm sure we can beat the Ten Lords!
Leave this to me alone! Tongtian isn't far off now! Don't waste your strength here!
But bro...
Don't you trust me?
It's not that... I just don't want to see another...
Don't worry, bro~ I won't die! That I can promise you!
Okay. Take care, bro~
Ho ho... You, all by yourself?
That's right! Just me!
Heh heh... Great master... great student... To think the Ten Lords... would fall to you...
Huff... huff... To beat you... I used up... every bit... of my chi... Sorry... bro...
There's no turning back now. On to the next floor!
Th-this is the Ten Lords? So bro won... Then where is he? Why hasn't he caught up yet?
I think my brother has used up all his chi by now. He can't fight anymore...
Then let's hurry back and treat his wounds!
No!
But if this keeps up...
That's right! He might not survive his wounds...
Then all the more reason to go back! I can't just stand by and watch my friends leave me one by one!

Monkey-face, if you insist on going back to save him instead of pushing on, even if he recovers, he won't thank you for it! Every choice we make right now decides the future of the Three Realms! We can't make a single wrong move! Am I right, Monkey-face~
Busybody... thank you...
Wh-what's with the thanks?! What are you saying, Monkey-face...
Xiaojun...
Let's go!
Mm!
Ha ha ha ha... Brats! You've finally come!
Shen Gongbao!
This is all your fault! So many people died because of you! I'll avenge them!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha... Let's see how strong these generals' stars really are!
Heh heh... Then don't you regret it, Shen Gongbao~
Hold it right there, all of you!!
He's MY prey! The next floor is the top, where Tongtian waits! It's up to you now, Monkey-face~
Do you know what you're saying, Busybody?! You think you can take Shen Gongbao alone?!
How will I know unless I try? Hurry up and go! The fate of the Three Realms rests with you three now!
Understood! Please be careful, Miss Yang Jian.
I know! Now go!
But...
Hurry, drag Monkey-face out of here!
With me, Shen Gongbao, here, none of you are leaving!
Heh heh heh heh heh...
What's so funny?
Hey, Busybody~ Now you've got no excuse to chase us off, huh!
Let's fight side by side, Miss Yang Jian!
Hmph! Suit yourselves!
Huff... huff... You... you...
So this... is your true... power... Shen... Gong...bao...
Heh... heh... I never thought... your power... could match... mine...
Huff... huff... What a... Shen... Gongbao...
Heh... heh... Give... up...! You're... no match... for me... Shen Gongbao...
Y-you... can still... stand...? Not... bad... at all...
N-not bad... Busybody...
Thanks... thanks... Now come with me...
Where are... you taking... us... Busybody...
Sh-shut up...
Hyah!
Huff... huff...
Blab...ber...mouth... what are... you doing...
Don't... worry... Monkey...face... You'll... recover... in a bit...
Busy... Busybody...
Monkey...face... let me ask you...
What...
If... you'd met me... before Ji Xiaojun... would you... have liked... me...?
Of all... the times... to ask... such a dumb... question...
It's... not dumb... at all... Answer me...
Blab...ber...mouth...
Yes!
That's... all... I needed... to hear...
Yang... Yang... Jian...
Why... did you... come back...
Do you... need to... ask...? To... finish... you... of course...
Heh... heh... You can't... even... stand... and you... want to... take me on...
Aaah...
What... are you... trying...? You must... know... you have... no chi... left... to keep... fighting...
Of course... I know... But... I can still... unleash... the Tiangang... Demon Quake...
Are... you mad?! If you use... the Chan Sect's... forbidden... Tiangang Demon Quake...
Of course... I know... Take... this... Tiangang... Demon... Quake...
Could it be...?
Miss Yang Jian...
Pingyan...
Pingyan...
Let's go! Only Tongtian is left...
Pingyan...
... Do as he says, Xiaojun...
So you're Tongtian?
All for your stupid ambitions! Do you know how many people have died?!
For the future of the Three Realms, we're taking you down! Prepare to die, Tongtian~!
Ho ho ho ho ho...
Th-that voice...?
Long time no see, Pingyan~
J-J-Ji...
Uncle Ji!?
Don't you recognize your old man? Pingyan~
P-Pa? Th-this can't be real! Weren't you dead? D-don't tell me you're...
Just as you suspect. I am Tongtian!
Uncle... you're joking, right?
N-no way...?

No~!! I don't believe it! You're lying to me! Tell me you're lying, please! Pa! The Tongtian we're after is the evil the Supreme Patriarch cast out to reach the Way! Do you know how many thousands of years ago that was?! How could you be Tongtian?! Besides, Pa! Didn't you die at Songmentan?!

The Supreme Patriarch! Hmph! That ungrateful Taoist cast me out to reach the Way, then joined Indra to crush my Jie Sect, ruin my demon world, and seal me here for 4,000 years! Ho ho ho... If I hadn't met that wicked brat Shen Gongbao 2,000 years ago, I might still be asleep in this tower!

2,000 years ago, Shen Gongbao tried to revive me and restore the Jie Sect, but Yuanshi's cursed disciple Jiang Ziya sealed us both in the Investiture Altar. Yet there we learned the key: the blood of resentful generals' stars could break my seal. To find you, born 2,000 years later, I spent all my chi to send a sliver of my soul out of the tower. I found you, the reborn stars, but even as children you brimmed with righteous power. With so little soul left, I couldn't even get near you, let alone strike.
So you possessed my Pa?
No! Your father was killed by a monster while hunting demons when you were three. So I used a spell to borrow his body...
Then answer me this! Why did you never lay a finger on me in all these years? Why did you save me at Songmentan?
Draw! You're a general's star, I'm the demon lord. This day had to come.
You raised me, and I owe you for that. But for the Three Realms, I still have to defeat you!
Well said! Draw your sword!
Forgive me! Pa... no! Tongtian!
Ho ho ho... You've grown, Pingyan~ Let me show you my final form!
Final form?
Hah!
Take this!
Im...pressive... Who'd think... I, Tongtian... would fall... to you...
Huff... huff...
Are... you... okay... Pingyan...
I... I can... hang on... huff... huff...
Hurry... and seal... Tongtian... in the List...
Huff... huff...
Pingyan...
I'll ask... you once... more... At Song...men...tan... why... did you... save... me...
An...answer... me...
I... I don't... know... myself... my child...
Heh... heh... "My child," huh... I... get it...
Y-Yin Wen... take care... of Xiaojun...
Pingyan... what are... you saying? What... are you... going to do?
Pangu... and Nuwa... told me... once the List... is complete... one general's star... must be sealed... in it too... That's... a general's star's... fate...
Th-then that means...
I'm... a general's star... too... Let me... do it!
Thanks... for the offer... Yin Wen... Take good... care... of Xiaojun...
Nooo!!
Pingyan~!
My child~!!
Pingyan...
That brat! Always like this, always running ahead of me! At this rate, I'll never catch up with him...
Ho ho ho... There'll be plenty more chances~
There's no turning back now. On to the next floor!
